description: This PHP class defines a formatter for pay period values within the OrangeHRM system, implementing the ValueFormatter interface and providing a method to return the formatted value or a default label when no value is provided.

classes.name: FormatWithPayPeriod
classes.description: A class that formats pay period values, returning the provided value or a default message when the value is absent.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the entity value if it exists; otherwise, returns a default 'No Pay Grade Details' message.
